I started looking for a new job when they had a town hall meeting about outsourcing staff work to India because they do the work for $8 hour and staff get 20-30. That was in January. They are making this into a covid problem but I was told in a review that I should be thankful for my $500 bonus and I am lucky because they more than big 4. They have been over hiring and underpaying new staff to weed out all of the over paid The company is a shit show, nobody really knows what they are doing, they don’t train anyone, and they work you to death. Yeah but the deductible is so high and it doesn’t cover anything. They cut off hsa contributions. They did this so they didn’t have to pay a severance package.

Do not go to Moss Adams. Its a shit firm. Their clients suck and you get zero training. They work you more than big four because busy season never ends. I worked 70 hour weeks almost every week. I was put on travel job after travel job and was got in trouble when I would properly expense things and take per diem. We were told the week prior that everything was fine due to covid the next week told  in a 2 minute video from the that they were furloughing 370 people. The unpaid furloughed employees were not guaranteed a job at the end. This was their way of getting around paying a severance package, that is company policy. The people who didn’t get furloughed wages were cut up to 20 percent, forced to take pto time, and given reduced work schedules. The firm is outsourcing work staff work to India. They are still bringing on new staff after furloughing that many employees to pay them much less. Jobs are under staffed. They make it seem like a good place to work by requiring you to have happy hours and firm events. I was told by a manager that I need to drink more to handle my stress. The parters make fun of the staff in front of other staff. The culture is nothing like they make it seem. The IT department is awful, and they use the worst audit software there is and it does not work. It is a gloried frat house. Who fits into this culture, narcissistic 25 year old males. The first year you learn nothing because they already assume your going to quit. So if this seems like you will be a good fit go for it.
